---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability, CLI command, gate, or block/field type
title: "feat(scope): short description"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve?**
What can't you currently do, or what currently requires a workaround?

**Proposed approach**
How would this fit the existing model — a new `defineBlock`/`defineDocument`
call, a new gate, a CLI command, a studio field renderer, etc.?

**Does this belong here?**
Check the README's "Not built, on purpose" section first (auth, media
pipeline, rich-text editor, real-time multiplayer, i18n, role matrix are
explicitly out of scope). If your proposal overlaps one of those, explain
why it's different.

**Alternatives considered**

**Suggested level**
Level 1 / Level 2 — your best guess is fine, a maintainer will confirm.
